title: Reading Drill — Comparing weaving samples — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Comparing weaving samples — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Ravensmere began with reports of samples tightening differently when removed from a loom. The textile tutor had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using marked rulers and chose change in width as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was a standard resting period. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted ten weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded the fibre thickness as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
